title: Low-degree Fourier weight and second moment
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Its variance equals its total influence if and only if the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients indexed by subsets of size at most one equals the uniform second moment of $f$, namely $\mathbb{E}[f(x)^2]$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$
